assertions.name: braid_is_linear_chain_not_all_pairs
assertions.source: interface crossings at {3k−1} number A−1 (deuteron 1, ⁴He 3) — the path graph P_A, not K_A; all-pairs binom(A,2) refuted as the braid multiplicity.

description: Resolves the θ_λ bond-count convention: the atomic braid recipe places A−1 inter-nucleon crossings at generators 3k−1 (consecutive blocks) — a LINEAR CHAIN (path graph P_A), NOT all-pairs binom(A,2) (K_A). ⁴He has 3 bonds (gens 2,5,8), not binom(4,2)=6. binom(A,2) in the mba-9b note is superseded by the linear-chain A−1 / binom(A+1,3) aggregate. No fit.
